APPLICATION FOR ENROLLMENT IN A NONRESERVATION SCHOOL. (For a child enrolled at an AGENCY) For and in consideration of the Government of the United States assuming the care, education and maintenance in the United States Indian School at Lacamas Ranch of Charley McDonald Male age 12 date of birth 1906 Name of child: Charley McDonald Sex: Male Date of birth: 1906 Tribe: Okanagan Name of Father Living or Dead: John McDonald Living Indian and English: White Tribe: White Band: None Degree of Indian Blood: None Name of Mother: Maggie McDonald Living Tribe: Okanagan I, John McDonald, do hereby voluntarily consent and agree to his enrollment in said school for a period of three years, and also obligate myself to abide by all the rules and regulations for Indian Schools. I hereby certify that I have this day carefully examined the above-named child herein proposed for transfer and find him to be in proper physical condition to attend school, and not afflicted with tuberculosis or any disease which would be a menace to the health of other pupils. This 9th day of September 1918 Walter S. Johnston Physician at Culville Agency. CERTIFICATE OF AGENT OR BONDED SUPERINTENDENT. I hereby certify that the statements made in the foregoing application and certificate, to the best of my knowledge and belief, are true; that the consent of Parent of guardian was voluntary. Dear Sir: Enclosed herewith find Official Receipt No. 176054 for transfer of $10.00 and $25.00 for Charles McDonald and Harry McDonald, respectively. Very respectfully, Superintendent. /HC Enc. John McDonald Reservation... Colville, Washington Tuition for the year ending... 5/14/20, $200 Superintendent's Certificate. 1. Certificate of Inability to Pay. I hereby certify that neither Charles McDonald nor his parents have any funds or income out of which they are financially able to pay the above bill or any part thereof. 2. Certificate of Partial Ability to Pay. I hereby certify that... or his parents can meet the above bill in part, and that $... is considered to be a fair amount for them to contribute to the education of this student. Fred Corrigan Supt. Colville Indian Agency, Nespelem, Wash. Superintendent. Superintendents are requested to assist this office in making collection of the amount of tuition due, when circumstances justify its payment. If parents are able to pay a part of the amount, please fill out Certificate 2, and arrange for the collection of the amount recommended. If parents or pupils are unable to meet this expense, Certificate 1 should be filled. Please return this statement with the proper notation. Very respectfully, Superintendent.
